title: Configuring the Attack Surface Report Notification

blocks.text: The Attack Surface Report notification keeps you posted on the latest available report for download by sending an email notification to the configured email address.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Analytics > Reports > Attack Surface Report.
In the Notify window, enter the email address in the Email Address field, then click Add Items.

You can enter multiple entries. Press Enter after each entry, then click Add Items. For item lists, you can view up to 32 items; filter the list by searching for a word, phrase, or number contained in an item; and remove all items from the list (Remove All) or only specific items from the list (X).
